pf0_sensitivity_config.grid: Unchanged original 144 PF0 geometry/flow/wall/beta combinations per demand scenario
pf0_sensitivity_config.retained_assumptions: D=2e-9, Km=.028, inlet=.2, threshold=.05 and all geometry are uncalibrated for these subjects. Gas basis is not established by inspected primary source. No claim these endpoints bound real constructs.
pf0_sensitivity_config.checks: Conservation, boundedness, no-demand limit, equal Q*beta, demand ordering; eight prespecified high-demand low-wall corner refinements plus closest-threshold case per scenario. Classifications near threshold flagged.

original_replay: Returned script is preserved and run byte-for-byte unchanged in original_replay cwd; raw and outputs are siblings. Its scientific statements remain unendorsed.
